intro.speaker: archive
intro.text: You're locked in the archive with one study. Each room opens when you've understood one part of it.

rooms.title: The timing room
rooms.description: Two clocks on the wall: five minutes and one week.

rooms.title: The filing room
rooms.description: Two cabinets, labelled RETRIEVAL and RE-EXPOSURE.

rooms.title: The planning room
rooms.description: A metro map and a note: exam next week.

item.prompt: The exit lock wants the study in the right order.

steps.text: One group re-reads; the other writes down what they remember
One-week test: the recall group clearly ahead

item.why: That is the order the passage reports.

sourceRefs.quote: In the study, students read a short passage. One group read it again; the other group wrote down everything they could remember.
Five minutes later the re-reading group did slightly better.
One week later the recall group remembered clearly more.

hints: What happened first, and which test came last?

outro.speaker: archive
outro.text: The door clicks open. You rebuilt the study from memory — which is the whole point.
